main_text.p: dum, pulsus vacuus, plenus, gravis, levis, cognosci nequeunt ; proinde à nobis negligentur. Quod de pulsibus dicitur, subjecta figura illustrat.

Pulsus compositi dicuntur, qui ex simplicibus constant ; quorum licet plurimæ sint differentiæ, singulę tamen ex quinque speciebus simplicibus componuntur, exempli causa, magnus, celer, creber, vehemēs, mollis, vel mediocris, mediocris, mediocris

page.notes: The diagram is a hand with five fingers and their pulse labels as listed; the labels are set in small type on the drawing. The right-hand edge shows cropped marginal text of the facing page, not transcribed. Printed "mediocris" repeated at line end as printed.
